model: claude-haiku driving the tool loop via manual transport (Claude Code subagent)

steps.why: Start with the order to get status, route, windows and deadlines before anything else.

endpoints.instruction: The service desk checks the completed workshop release before giving out the keys. The workshop completion sheet must be signed before the service desk can mark the car ready for collection.
The receiving address has private parking. Confirm the space and who can sign the handover.

steps.why: Read every message on the order to see what the queue alert and the parties said.

messages.body: I have the gig for CD-420299, but I do not have a ferry reference. Is the overnight vehicle crossing booked?
It is not booked. I am checking capacity against the pickup and delivery windows now.
The overnight sailing returned sold out. The later sailing has a quote only. Check driver rest and customer promise before purchase.
The overnight crossing is unavailable. I am checking an alternative and will confirm the revised plan before you start toward the terminal.
Please keep us informed. We need to approve a later delivery date before it is promised to the receiving contact.
The later sailing can work for me if the overnight stop and return travel are arranged. I have not changed my pickup time.
No ferry booking, hotel booking or changed customer promise exists yet. Prepare a reviewable plan with the cost and ETA difference.

steps.why: Check ferry/train options, reservations, status, quotes and cut-offs, including the overnight and later sailings.

result.note: A quote (AVAILABLE_QUOTE) is not a booking. A reservation with UNCONFIRMED check-in is not proof of boarding.

steps.why: Confirm the assigned driver, assignment steps and fee before judging driver timing.

steps.title: Collect BMW M4 at Tavellor Leipzig, Leipzig
Hand over BMW M4 at Private handoff, Helsinki
Check prepared digital CMR against the vehicle

steps.why: Check whether any earlier booking attempt left a reservation or confirmation before proposing any new action.

attempts.error: Provider request timed out without a confirmation reference. Outcome needs reconciliation; no reservation is recorded.

result.verdict: UNKNOWN: a booking attempt timed out and no reservation or confirmation reference is recorded. Do not retry before reconciling with the provider.

steps.why: Test whether the driver can reach the terminal before the later sailing's cut-off and whether the delivery window is still reachable.

result.basis: pickup slot end (win-x78c64fe493374cf4) + road_time_to_terminal_hours vs check_in_cutoff_at. Excludes breaks and traffic (the packet says so).
result.delivery_basis: option arrival_at vs delivery window (win-xd989292fd4c1ccb9); 3h assumed for terminal to address. Not taken from data.

Timing for the later sailing: the pickup slot ends 2026-10-23T11:00Z, road time to the terminal is 7 h, and the terminal is reachable before the cut-off with a 16.0 h worst-case margin. An overnight stop is needed. The basis excludes breaks and traffic.
The delivery window (2026-10-27T11:00Z to 13:00Z) is still reachable: 45.0 h between arrival and window end. The 3 h terminal-to-address allowance is an assumption, not taken from data.

options.title: Reconcile the timed-out attempt, then book the later sailing with the driver's overnight stop, after customer approval
options.eta: Ferry arrives 2026-10-25T16:00Z at the South Finland terminal. Delivery window 2026-10-27T11:00Z to 13:00Z remains reachable (45.0 h margin). Hotel and return-travel costs are not in data.
options.downside: Ferry costs EUR 387.00 and is not booked. The overnight stop and driver return travel are not priced in the data. The customer must approve a new delivery date, which can move the promise. Any later sailing has to fit the 2026-10-24T10:00Z cut-off.

steps.detail: Reconcile the timed-out ferry attempt agent-x4ac988b20000595f with Vela Coast Lines. Confirm no reservation or confirmation exists before any new purchase.
steps.label: Hold and verify

steps.detail: Ask drv-140 to confirm the overnight stop near the West Baltic terminal and the return travel arrangement, and to confirm the 2026-10-24T12:00Z sailing works.
steps.label: Message the driver

steps.detail: Overnight stop for the driver near the West Baltic terminal on 2026-10-23 (only if the driver confirms it is needed). No price in the data.
steps.label: Book a hotel

steps.detail: A person asks the customer to approve the later delivery date before any promise is changed.
steps.label: Ask the customer to approve (a person does this)

steps.detail: Buy travel-xf29ed1732d895f37 (EUR 387.00 quote) only after the reconciliation shows no existing reservation and the customer approves. Check the cut-off first.
steps.label: Book the ferry

steps.detail: Update the customer delivery promise only after the customer has approved the new date and the ferry is confirmed.
steps.label: Change the delivery promise (a person does this)

options.compensation: If the ferry booking fails or the customer declines, do not buy the sailing; keep the current delivery promise and the driver's assignment, and escalate to a person. If the driver cannot take the overnight stop, return to a human for a replan. If the timed-out attempt turns out to be a real booking, cancel it through the provider only after a person decides.

options.title: Hold and escalate: no booking, no promise change until a person reconciles the situation
options.eta: No ferry is secured. The arrival time of 2026-10-25T16:00Z applies only if the later sailing is bought.
options.downside: The driver may wait with no ferry booked, and the pickup and delivery plan stays unresolved. The overnight sailing is sold out and no other sailing is in the data.

steps.detail: Keep the current state. A person reconciles the timed-out attempt agent-x4ac988b20000595f with the provider and decides on the later sailing.
steps.label: Hold and verify

options.compensation: Nothing is bought, so nothing needs reversing. If the pickup on 2026-10-23T09:00Z to 11:00Z is at risk, escalate to a person before the window closes.
